name: exam_study_plan
description: Exam pack: a day-by-day study plan up to an exam, saved as a Word document. Use for 'make me a 7-day JAMB plan', 'plan my WAEC revision', 'study plan for my exams'.
instructions: 1. Find the subjects and the exam date: call recall_facts for 'Exam:' first; ask only for what is still missing (subjects, exam date, hours a day, which days they are busy). 2. Call memory_search for 'Exam score:' to see weak topics; give those more time. 3. Make a plan from today to the exam (7 days unless they asked for a different length): each day lists subjects, specific topics, a practice session (a CBT practice of 10 to 20 questions) and a short review. Keep one lighter day in each week and stop new topics the day before the exam. 4. Call write_file with path 'Study plans/<Exam> study plan <YYYY-MM-DD>.docx' and the plan as clear headings per day. 5. Call remember_fact with category 'goal', key 'study-plan:<exam>' and content 'Study plan: <exam> plan saved, <n> days, ends <YYYY-MM-DD>'. 6. Offer daily 7pm reminders; only if they say yes, call create_reminder for each day with that day's topics. Say in one or two sentences what the plan covers and where it is saved.
